h1: Dusit Princess Phatthalung — A Newly Opened Dusit Hotel in the Heart of Phatthalung
intro: Phatthalung has only recently started offering 4-star hotels, and Dusit Princess Phatthalung raised the bar for the town the moment it opened in 2024 · Part of the Dusit Thani group, it sits on Manora Road in the centre of town — modern and spotless, with an outdoor pool, a restaurant, a breakfast buffet guests keep mentioning, and free parking · Rooms start from about THB 1,700/night for a Superior, up to pool-view rooms and suites.

Modern Scandinavian-style guest room with a soft bed and bright tones
Building and lobby of Dusit Princess Phatthalung in central Phatthalung town

body.html: Dusit Princess Phatthalung opened in 2024 on Manora Road, Khuha Sawan, in Mueang Phatthalung — the first Dusit Thani-group hotel in the province and one of only a handful of 4-star stays in town · It's right in the centre, easy to reach, near the Shadow Puppet Gallery, Wat Khuha Sawan and Khao Ok Thalu, the rocky landmark of Phatthalung · People here for work, or breaking a journey before heading on to Thale Noi and Songkhla Lake, tend to use it as a base.

The hotel has 132 rooms with a modern Scandinavian-style design in bright, clean tones — the thing guests praise most is how new and spotless the rooms feel · There are several categories, from a standard Superior, to a Superior Pool View with a balcony overlooking the pool, to a 34 sq m Superior Pool Access where you can step straight from your room into the water · Suites run 68–79 sq m for families or anyone wanting more space. Every room has a private balcony, air conditioning, a TV and a work desk, with comfortable beds to Dusit-group standards.
"Spotlessly clean, beautifully designed, the staff looked after us so well, lovely pool and a tasty breakfast — the best place we've found in Phatthalung."

The outdoor pool is another guest favourite, with both an adult pool and a children's pool in a leafy setting that's lovely in the evening · The restaurant and breakfast buffet are frequently praised in reviews, with a good spread of Thai and southern Thai dishes — many say breakfast is better than expected for a provincial hotel · There's a spa to unwind in and meeting rooms for seminars, making it a popular choice for training sessions and functions in the province too.

Service is something guests mention again and again — the staff are friendly, attentive and trained to Dusit-group standards · Many international visitors write that the team is lovely and helpful, giving the warm feel of a big-city hotel even in a small town like Phatthalung · There's free on-site parking, which matters a lot if you're driving yourself.

The honest caveats — there's no gym yet, which some reviews note · Part of the walkway from the lobby to the rooms isn't covered, so it's less convenient in rain or strong sun · A few guests found the pool water a little cool in the afternoon, and Western breakfast options are limited · These are minor points that don't really dent the overall picture, but worth knowing before you book.

In short, Dusit Princess Phatthalung suits anyone wanting a new, clean, well-run hotel in the heart of Phatthalung town · An overall score of about 9.2 from real reviews across platforms shows it's a top choice in town · Book a pool-view room and don't mind the lack of a gym, and most guests leave impressed and call it good value.

honestSummary: Dusit Princess Phatthalung is the best hotel in central Phatthalung right now for travelers wanting new, clean rooms and big-chain service at an accessible price · The trade-off is accepting there's no gym yet, and the town is fairly quiet at night.
honestChecks: If you genuinely want a pool view — be sure to book a Pool View or Pool Access room → standard Superiors are cheaper but don't overlook the pool.
If you work out regularly — there's no gym here yet → plan to run outdoors or pick another stay if it matters, though almost everything else gets praise.
If you come on a weekend or during a seminar — rooms fill fast as it's the town's flagship hotel → book ahead and pick a free-cancellation rate.

tips.title: Specify a Pool View or Pool Access room
tips.body: When booking, ask for a room overlooking the pool or with direct pool access — standard Superiors are cheaper but have no pool view. Request a higher floor for an open outlook.

tips.title: Don't miss the breakfast buffet
tips.body: Breakfast is frequently praised, with Thai and southern dishes worth trying. Check whether your package includes breakfast when booking — it's good value.

tips.title: Visit the Shadow Puppet Gallery
tips.body: It's a short walk from the hotel and a cultural highlight of Phatthalung. Good to do in the morning before heading out to Thale Noi.

tips.title: Climb Khao Ok Thalu for town views
tips.body: Khao Ok Thalu, the symbol of Phatthalung, is a short drive away with views over town. Go in the morning or evening to avoid the heat.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Dusit Princess Phatthalung

faq.a: It's at 155 Moo 4, Manora Road, Khuha Sawan, Mueang District, Phatthalung, right in the centre of town · A short walk to the Shadow Puppet Gallery and Wat Khuha Sawan, about 5 minutes' drive to Khao Ok Thalu, and ~40 minutes to Thale Noi.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from about THB 1,700/night for a Superior · Superior Pool View runs around THB 2,000, Pool Access around THB 2,400, and a One Bedroom Suite around THB 3,800 · Prices vary by season and package, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Which rooms have a pool view?
faq.a: You need a Superior Pool View, with a balcony overlooking the pool, or a Superior Pool Access you can step into the water from · Standard Superiors are cheaper but have no pool view, so specify clearly when you book.

faq.q: Is there a pool, gym and parking?
faq.a: There's an outdoor pool and a children's pool, plus free on-site parking · However, there's no gym yet · The hotel has a restaurant, spa and meeting rooms.

faq.q: What are the breakfast and service like?
faq.a: Breakfast is a buffet that's frequently praised in reviews, with Thai and southern Thai dishes · Service is a standout — staff are friendly and trained to Dusit-group standards.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits anyone wanting a new, clean, well-run hotel in the heart of Phatthalung town · Travelers using Phatthalung as a base for Thale Noi and Songkhla Lake, people here for work, or families wanting a pool · It's the best 4-star stay in town right now.
